users.subtitle: People who have an account, newest first

invites.subtitle: Invite links and who they were made for

sms.subtitle: Gateways, routing, message texts and limits

audit.title: Audit
audit.subtitle: What the admins have done, newest first

copyFailed: The text could not be copied. Select it and copy it by hand.
copyNote: Closing this window or leaving this step empties the clipboard, whatever it holds by then, so something you copied from another app after this value is lost too. If the browser refuses at that moment, the clipboard is emptied when you come back to this tab. The clipboard history that Windows and some other systems keep is out of our reach: clear it yourself.

result.warning: This is shown only once. Copy it now: it cannot be shown again.
result.confirmText: This value will not be shown again. If you have not copied it, you will have to make a new one.

login.title: Admin sign-in
login.subtitle: Sign in with your username, password and authenticator code.
login.usernameInvisible: The username has a character that cannot be seen. Retype it.
login.totpHint: Leave this empty the very first time you sign in.
login.ended: Your session ended. Sign in again to continue.
login.stalled: The sign-in did not hold. Your browser may be blocking cookies for this site. Try again.

password.title: Choose your password
password.subtitle: The password you were given works once. Replace it with one only you know.
password.currentWrong: The one-time password is not correct, or it has expired.
password.expiry: A one-time password lasts 24 hours. If it has expired, ask the person who runs the server to issue a new one with <cmd>{command}</cmd>.

totp.title: Connect an authenticator
totp.subtitle: Every sign-in and every sensitive change will ask for a code from it.
totp.scan: Scan the code with an authenticator app, or type the key into it by hand.
totp.showNote: Already scanned a key on this device? Type its code below. Showing a new code makes a new key, and the entry you scanned stops working.
totp.qrTitle: QR code for the authenticator app
totp.verify: Then type the six-digit code the app shows.
totp.noRecovery: An admin has no recovery codes. If you lose the authenticator, the person who runs the server can reset it with <cmd>{command}</cmd>.
totp.restarted: The key you were shown is no longer valid, so a new one was made. Scan it again.

done.title: You are all set
done.subtitle: Your password and authenticator are in place.

fresh.title: Confirm with your authenticator
fresh.text: This change needs a fresh code. Enter the six digits your app shows now. If you just used that code, wait for the next one.

account.title: Change password
account.text: Choose a new password. You will stay signed in here, and every other session will end.
account.totpHint: The code your authenticator app shows now.
account.sessionsNote: Other sessions of this account end when the password changes.

password_reset.title: The console reset your password
password_reset.text: This happened on {time}. If you did not ask for it, tell the person who runs the server.

totp_reset.title: The console reset your authenticator
totp_reset.text: This happened on {time}. If you did not ask for it, tell the person who runs the server.

sms_gateway_changed.title: An SMS gateway was changed
sms_gateway_changed.text: This happened on {time}. Check the SMS page and the audit log to see what changed.

generic.title: A notice about your account
generic.text: This was recorded on {time}. Check the audit log.

generic.title: An alert needs attention
generic.text: Open the SMS page or the audit log for details.

sms_gateway.title: SMS gateway {provider} has a problem
sms_gateway.transient: Messages through it are failing for now. The fallback takes over while it does.
sms_gateway.auth: It refused the key or login. Enter the credentials again on the SMS page.
sms_gateway.credit: The account is out of credit. Add credit with the provider.
sms_gateway.config: A template, parameter or sender is set up wrongly. Check the template mappings.
sms_gateway.recipient: It refused a number. No other gateway was tried.
sms_gateway.blacklisted: A number is on the telecom blacklist. The fallback was tried.
sms_gateway.other: It reported a problem. Check the gateway on the SMS page.

sms_down.title: Text messages cannot be sent
sms_down.text: No gateway can send right now. Sign-in by SMS code and registration by SMS code are down.

sms_outbox_cap.title: The daily SMS outbox cap was reached
sms_outbox_cap.text: Messages are held until the cap resets, or until you raise it under Limits.

sms_payload.title: A message could not be built
sms_payload.text: A queued message had an unusable payload and ended unsent.

empty.title: No users yet
empty.text: Create one with the plus button.
empty.searchText: No number starts with what you typed.
empty.notNumberText: This is not the start of a mobile number. Type digits, for example 0912.

create.title: Create a user
create.text: The user gets a one-time password to sign in with. It works without an SMS gateway and must be changed at the first sign-in.
create.lost: No answer came, so the user may now exist with a one-time password you did not see. It cannot be shown again. Check the list before you try again.

result.title: User created
result.intro: Give the user this one-time password. They must change it when they sign in.

empty.title: No invites yet
empty.text: Create one with the plus button.

create.title: Create an invite
create.text: An invite is one link for one phone number. You see it once, after you create it. Nothing is sent by SMS.
create.phoneHint: The invite works only for this number.
create.ttlRange: Enter a whole number of hours from 1 to {max, number}.
create.lost: No answer came, so the invite may now exist with a link you did not see. It cannot be shown again. Check the list, and revoke it before you make another.

result.title: Invite created
result.intro: Nothing is sent by SMS. Copy the link and give it to the person yourself. If you lose it, revoke the invite and make a new one.

revoke.title: Revoke this invite?
revoke.text: The invite for {phone} will stop working. This cannot be undone.

refreshFailed: Refreshing failed. What you see and what you typed are kept, but the values may be out of date.

conflict.text: Another admin changed this while you were editing. The server now holds:
conflict.refreshed: Another admin changed these values while you were editing. The form now shows the server's values. Check them and press Save again.

body.invalid: The text was refused. Check the number of placeholders, and remove any link.
body.too_long: The text needs more than one billed part. A login-code text or a security notice must fit one part.

rp_id.invalid: This is not a valid RP ID. Use the host name only: no spaces, no https:// and no port.

fieldErrors.out_of_range: It is outside the allowed range.
fieldErrors.not_available: It cannot be turned on yet.
fieldErrors.same_as_primary: It must be a different gateway from the primary one.
fieldErrors.count: The number of names does not match.
fieldErrors.unknown: It is not a known value.
fieldErrors.same_as_current: It must differ from the current one.
fieldErrors.not_panel_host: It must be this panel's own domain, or a parent domain of it.
fieldErrors.public_suffix: It is a public suffix such as .ir, not a domain of yours.
fieldErrors.price_required: Every gateway the route can use needs a price first, while a daily money cap is set.
fieldErrors.pending_confirmation: Its new credentials wait for the owner's confirmation at the server console.
fieldErrors.pending_exists: A pair of credentials already waits at the server console, so this save was refused. Only the session that saved it holds the fingerprint that confirms it. If you did not just save it yourself, someone else may have: discard it at the console (ctrlz-admin sms discard), check the admin sessions, and then save yours again.

gateways.breaker: The gateway is paused until {time} after repeated failures.
gateways.pendingText: New credentials are saved but not active yet. The owner confirms them at the server console, and the confirm command needs the fingerprint that was shown once when they were saved. See what waits with <cmd>{command}</cmd>. If the fingerprint was lost, discard them at the console and save them again.

staged.title: Confirm the credentials at the console
staged.intro: Run this line at the server console to activate the credentials of {provider}. Replace {placeholder} with the hint that {pending} shows for them. The fingerprint is part of the line and is shown only here, once.

edit.title: Credentials of {provider}
edit.text: Leave a field empty to keep what is saved. Credentials are sealed when you save and are never shown again.
edit.melipayamakPasswordHint: Paste the API key from the web service settings of the provider's panel. It is not the password you sign in with.
edit.ipNote: The panel server's outgoing address must be on each gateway's list of allowed addresses.
edit.costInvalid: Enter a number, with up to four decimals, or leave it empty.
edit.nothing: Type a credential or a price to change.
edit.savedPending: Credentials saved. They stay inactive until the owner confirms them at the server console.
edit.noFingerprint: Credentials saved, but the answer carried no usable fingerprint, so they cannot be confirmed. Discard them at the server console and save them again.
edit.lost: No answer came, so the credentials may be waiting at the server console without the fingerprint that confirms them, and it cannot be shown again. See what waits with {pending}. If this gateway is listed, discard it with {discard} and save the credentials again.

test.title: Test send through {provider}
test.text: A real message goes through this gateway only. It does not fall back to another one.
test.noTemplate: There is no template to send.
test.failed: The message could not be sent.

routing.title: Routing
routing.text: The primary gateway sends first. The fallback takes over when the primary fails.
routing.fallbackHint: It must be a different gateway from the primary one.
routing.same: The fallback must differ from the primary.
routing.noneConfigured: No gateway has credentials yet. Set them on the Gateways tab first.

templates.bodyHint: One line, with no link. '{code}' stands for the code.
templates.bodyInvalid: The text was refused. Check the number of placeholders, and remove any link.
templates.count: {characters} characters, {parts, plural, =0 {no parts} one {# billed part} other {# billed parts}} ({encoding}: {single} for one part, then {multi} each).
templates.otpTooLongFa: A login-code text must fit one billed part: at most {limit} characters in Persian, with the code filled in. Shorten it.
templates.otpTooLongEn: A login-code text must fit one billed part: at most {limit} characters in English, with the code filled in. Shorten it.
templates.noticeHint: One line, with no link and no placeholder. A security notice carries no value, so a test send takes none.
templates.noticeTooLongFa: A security notice must fit one billed part: at most {limit} characters in Persian. Shorten it.
templates.noticeTooLongEn: A security notice must fit one billed part: at most {limit} characters in English. Shorten it.
templates.noticeNotGsm: An English security notice may use only GSM characters. One other letter (an accent outside the GSM set, a Persian letter, an emoji) makes it a Unicode message of 70 characters per part.
templates.noticeNoCode: A security notice carries no value. Remove the placeholder.
templates.otpNotGsm: An English login-code text may use only GSM characters. One other letter (an accent outside the GSM set, a Persian letter, an emoji) makes it a Unicode message of 70 characters per part.
templates.mappingsHint: {count, plural, =0 {The text has no placeholders, so give no parameter names.} one {The text has # placeholder, so give one parameter name.} other {The text has # placeholders, so give one parameter name for each.}}
templates.paramNamesHint: Separate the names with commas, in the order of the placeholders.
templates.idInvalid: Enter the template ID: digits only, up to 18, above zero.
templates.idInvalidSmsir: This gateway takes a template ID from 1 to 2147483647: digits only.
templates.namesInvalid: Use up to {max, number} names made of letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

limits.title: Limits
limits.text: Caps on the codes that can be sent and on what the SMS service may spend each day.
limits.range: Enter a whole number from {min, number} to {max, number}.
limits.rangeMin: Enter a whole number, {min, number} or more.

otp_cap_phone.label: Per number
otp_cap_phone.hint: Codes to one number in an hour.

otp_cap_phone_net.label: Per number and network
otp_cap_phone_net.hint: Codes to one number from one network.

otp_cap_ip.label: Per address
otp_cap_ip.hint: Codes asked for from one address.

otp_cap_net24.label: Per network (/24)
otp_cap_net24.hint: Codes asked for from one small network.

otp_cap_phone_trusted.label: Per known number
otp_cap_phone_trusted.hint: A higher cap for a number that has signed in before.

otp_cap_net48.label: Per large network (/48)
otp_cap_net48.hint: Codes asked for from one large network.

otp_cap_global.label: In total
otp_cap_global.hint: Codes sent for everyone in an hour.

otp_soft_pct.label: Warning threshold (percent)
otp_soft_pct.hint: Raise an alert at this share of a cap.

sms_outbox_cap_daily.label: Outbox per day
sms_outbox_cap_daily.hint: Messages other than codes. 0 stops them.

sms_cost_cap_daily.label: Spending per day (Rial)
sms_cost_cap_daily.hint: Leave empty for no money cap.

stats.emptyText: Nothing was sent in the last {days, number} days.

settings.impactFailed: The effect could not be counted. Try again before you confirm.

registration.title: Registration

modeText.closed: Nobody can register. Only an admin can create a user.
modeText.invite: A person needs an invite link to register.
modeText.open: Anyone with a phone number can register.

registration.graceHint: Accounts claimed but never proven get this long to prove their number. From {min, number} to {max, number}.
registration.graceRange: Enter a whole number of days from {min, number} to {max, number}.

impact.title: Moving to {mode}
impact.graced: {count, plural, one {# unproven account gets a grace period.} other {# unproven accounts get a grace period.}}
impact.suspended: {count, plural, one {# account is suspended at once.} other {# accounts are suspended at once.}}

webauthn.title: Passkey
webauthn.text: The site address passkeys are tied to, and whether people can use them.
webauthn.rpIdHint: The panel's host name, or a suffix of it.
webauthn.rpInvalid: The RP ID has a character that cannot be seen. Retype it.
webauthn.rpMalformed: This is not a valid RP ID. Use the host name only: no spaces, no https:// and no port.
webauthn.enabledHint: Turn it on when the real domain is in place.
webauthn.originsHint: The server writes these from the panel's address. They cannot be edited here.

impact.title: Changing the RP ID
impact.rejected: Nothing can be counted until the RP ID is valid.
impact.credentials: {count, plural, one {# passkey becomes out of date.} other {# passkeys become out of date.}}
impact.users: {count, plural, one {# user is affected.} other {# users are affected.}}
impact.enforced: {count, plural, one {# of them signs in only with a passkey.} other {# of them sign in only with a passkey.}}

webauthn.refused: The server refused these values. In production it will not turn Passkey on until the real domain has been accepted.

filter.label: Action
filter.hint: An exact action name. Leave empty to see everything.
filter.invalid: An action name uses lowercase letters, digits, dots, dashes and underscores.

empty.title: Nothing recorded yet
empty.filterText: Try another action name, or clear the filter.
